hardware.how_does_the_krishiai: Kisaan Buddy smaart phaarm hab khud ko kaise paavar detaa hai?
hardware.the_device_runs_on: yah divaais maanak 5V maaikro-yooesabee paavar inaput par chalataa hai. dooradaraaj ke kshetron men, ise aamataur par ek bajat 10,000mAh yooesabee paavar baink (jo ise lagaataar 4-5 dinon tak chalaataa hai) kaa upayog karake snchaalit kiyaa jaataa hai yaa nirntar ऑph-grid snchaalan ke lie ek chhote 5W saur-chaarjing painal se joda़aa jaataa hai.
hardware.does_it_work_without: kyaa yah sakriy intaranet yaa vaAI-phaAI ke binaa kaam karataa hai?
hardware.the_hardware_node_uses: haardaveyar nod reeding ko seedhe Kisaan Buddy klaaud baikaend par bhejane ke lie ek antarnihit vaAI-phaAI maaikrochip (ESP32) kaa upayog karataa hai. yadi vaAI-phaAI asthaayee roop se ऑpha़laain hai, to ऑn-bord OLED skreen abhee bhee seedhe khet men vaastavik samay nidaan reeding pradaan karane ke lie kaam karegee.
hardware.how_long_will_the: geelee mittee men kaipesitiv maॉischar sensar kab tak chalegaa?
hardware.unlike_cheap_resistive_moisture: saste pratirodhee maॉischar prob ke vipareet (jo ujaagar dhaatu kaa upayog karate hain jo haphton men ilektroleesis ke kaaran snkshaarit ho jaate hain), Kisaan Buddy smaart phaarm hab men ek kaipesitiv maॉischar sensar v2.0 shaamil hai. yah sensar pooree tarah se insuleted hai, jo raasaayanik ksharan ko rokataa hai aur geelee mittee ke neeche kAI varshon kaa jeevanakaal sunishchit karataa hai.
hardware.how_does_the_ai: eaAI phasal anushnsaa is detaa kaa upayog kaise karatee hai?
hardware.once_your_device_id: ek baar jab aapakee divaais aAIdee pnjeekrit ho jaatee hai, to aapake kraॉp prediktar pej par ek neelaa 'laaiv ESP32 padha़en' batan milataa hai. ise klik karane se aapake bhautik kshetr ke laaiv sensar detaabes se taapamaan aur namee ke slaaidar turnt bhar jaate hain, jisase atyadhik sthaaneeyakrit kisaan vijnaan anushnsaaen sunishchit hotee hain.
hardware.can_i_assemble_this: kyaa main is divaais ko khud asenbal kar sakataa hoon?
hardware.yes_krishiai_supports_open: haan! Kisaan Buddy opan-sors IoT kaa samarthan karataa hai. ham snpoorn Arduino vaayaring gaaid aur pharmaveyar kod mupht men pradaan karate hain (HARDWARE_SETUP.md). aap lagabhag ₹1,200 men ESP32 bord aur sensar khareed sakate hain, ise prograam kar sakate hain aur apane khaate se link kar sakate hain.
hardware.mount_the_main_weatherproof: apanee lakshit phasalon ke kareeb ek saadhaaran lakada़ee ke khnbhe yaa baada़ ke post par mukhy mausam pratirodhee IP65 kaipsool sthaapit karen.
hardware.insert_the_waterproof_stainless: jalarodhak stenales-steel taapamaan prob (DS18B20) aur insuleted kaipesitiv mittee kee namee sensar ko seedhe jada़ kshetr (lagabhag 4-6 inch gaharaa) par jameen men daalen.
hardware.connect_a_micro_usb: kaipsool ke nichale hisse se ek maaikro-yooesabee kebal ko apane paavar srot (ek saur yooesabee baitaree baink yaa phon chaarjar edaaptar) se kanekt karen.
hardware.on_first_launch_enter: pahale laॉnch par, kaॉnpha़igareshan men apane sthaaneey raautar/haॉtaspaॉt kredenshiyal darj karen, aur ऑn-bord OLED skreen ko kanekt hote aur 'Sync OK' dikhaate hue dekhen!
hardware.the_krishiai_smart_farm: Kisaan Buddy smaart phaarm hab ek ऑl-in-van mausam pratirodhee kaipsool hai jo sookshm-jalavaayu sensar, graaunding prob aur sthaaneey nidaan ko ekeekrit karataa hai. yah vaastavik samay teleemetree ko seedhe phasal salaahakaaron men bhejane ke lie klaaud paaipalaainon se juda़taa hai.
hardware.designed_to_survive_extreme: atyadhik ushnakatibndheey mausam, tej Bharateey garmiyon aur bhaaree maanasoonee baarish men jeevit rahane ke lie dija़aain kiyaa gayaa. smaart hab ESP32 maaikrochip ko ek eyarataait kaipsool kesing ke andar rakhataa hai, paanee ke snchay se bachane ke lie kebal port ko rabar seel ke saath neeche kee or nirdeshit karataa hai.
hardware.built_in_2_4ghz: 100 meetar khulee renj ke saath nirmit 2.4GHz vaAI-phaAI enteenaa
hardware.ssd1306_local_oled_screen: tatkaal teleemetree jaanch ke lie SSD1306 sthaaneey OLED skreen disple
hardware.low_5v_power_requirement: kam 5V bijalee kee aavashyakataa — maanak saur yooesabee paavar bainkon ke saath sngat
hardware.corrosion_resistant_capacitive_moisture: bahu-varsheey prithvee embeding ke lie snkshaaran pratirodhee kaipesitiv namee prob
hardware.drag_the_sliders_below: vibhinn kisaan vaataavaranon kaa anukaran karane ke lie neeche die gae slaaidar kheenchen aur dekhen ki kaise smaart hab teleemetree vaastavik samay men eaAI bhavishyavaaniyon ko samaayojit karatee hai.
hardware.sliders_mimic_voltage_readouts: slaaidars ESP32 enaalaॉg GPIO pin men dijital strings men parivartit hone vaale voltej reedaaaut kee nakal karate hain.
hardware.precision_ml_matches_current: sateek masheen larning elgoridam is phasal kaa sujhaav dene ke lie vartamaan jalavaayu namee (${sensors.soilMoisture.val}%) aur vaayu taapamaan (${sensors.airTemp.val}°C) ko aitihaasik detaaset vitaranon ke saath milaataa hai.
hardware.sensors_capture_grounding_and: sensar jameen aur vaayumndaleey teleemetree detaa blaॉk kaipchar karate hain.
hardware.built_in_wi_fi: antarnihit vaAI-phaAI klaaint baikaend `/api/sensor/ingest` par pelod jeesaoen bhejataa hai.
hardware.precision_recommendation_logic_loads: parishuddhataa anushnsaa tark upayuktataa kee gananaa karane ke lie teleemetree lod karataa hai.
hardware.farmer_views_results_and: kisaan parinaam dekhataa hai aur apanee bhaashaa men turnt soochanaaen praapt karataa hai.
hardware.setting_up_the_hub: hab sthaapit karane men 30 minat se kam samay lagataa hai. kisee vishesh injeeniyaring kaushal kee aavashyakataa naheen hai.
hardware.fill_in_your_details: apanaa vivaran bharen, aur hamaaree sthaaneey teem aapase snpark karegee.
hardware.thank_you_for_contacting: Kisaan Buddy se snpark karane ke lie dhanyavaada. hamaaree teem jald hee aapase mobaail ke maadhyam se snpark karegee.
hardware.pre_order_pre_assembled: poorv-asembald smaart hab kaa ऑrdar karen (₹1,200 aavaran)
hardware.request_field_demonstration_setup: kshetreey pradarshan aur sahaayataa kaa anurodh karen
hardware.tell_us_about_your: hamen apanee mittee ke prakaar, paanee ke srot aadi ke baare men bataaen...
